title: Report actual cheat one-shot writes in the menu
changes: Report an explicit zero-write result with a suggestion to check conditions, or the actual positive write count, after applying a cheat once. Use the same localized result in the diagnostic message and cheat management panel.
Preserve the existing conditional execution behavior and machine-readable result; a successful zero-write application is not converted into an error.
validation: A focused Linux test checked zero and positive counts in English and Italian. Windows GNU test executable and frontend built. Evidence: target/validation/units/dbg20-cheat-feedback-build-uwmm9dtn/.

The focused Windows GNU test passed under Wine. A protected USA Wine/Xvfb menu session applied the conditional derived job once with one write and again with its condition false and zero writes; inspected bytes stayed unchanged on the second application, no guest frames advanced and no maintained cheat was armed. Screenshots of both messages were visually reviewed; protected inputs unchanged, normal close and Wine drained. Evidence: target/validation/units/dbg20-cheat-feedback-wine-0htinf7a/.
limitations: A positive count reports writes performed, not that game behavior is safe or verified. A zero count suggests checking conditions but does not diagnose every possible cause. Native Windows and physical-controller input were not tested.
